title: Reject predefined host file and server-program role authority at runtime admission
cause: The role query checks role attributes but these predefined roles confer privileged capabilities without rolsuper, rolbypassrls or authz DML grants. Runtime can assume a granted role even with its own NOINHERIT setting.
required_fix: Reject direct and indirect usable predefined elevated-role chains under the root-selected least-privilege runtime policy and add real-catalog regressions. Do not execute the privileged capabilities in the fixture.
scope: Finite runtime safety/admission guard; no public route or production exploitation is asserted.
safety: Only fixture GRANT, ordinary authorization evaluation and REVOKE ran. No server file or program action was invoked; owned cluster and scratch root were removed.
